title: urochloa glumaris
intro: Urochloa glumaris, commonly known as Signal Grass or Panic Grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Urochloa glumaris include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Urochloa glumaris include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
